skill: Solve a three-variable upper-triangular system using back substitution and select its ordered solution vector.
reasoning_steps: Read the third variable from the last equation.
Substitute into the second equation and isolate the second variable.
Substitute both known values into the first equation and isolate the first variable.
Match the ordered triple to one of five radio choices, in angle-vector or column-vector notation.

Easy signed integer and small rational arithmetic; two substitution stages.
One correct vector in five distinct choices; coordinate order follows variable order.

Vary signs, zero/nonzero values, and rational/integer status of solution coordinates; no source coordinate is intrinsically fixed.
Vary xyz versus indexed variable names, angle versus column vectors, correct-choice position and plausible wrong coordinate roles.

source_cases.problem:
Solve the following system of equations:
    

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}+{x}_{2}-{x}_{3} &=3 \\ {x}_{2}-{x}_{3} &=\frac{1}{2} \\ {x}_{3} &=2\end{aligned}\right.
$$

Solve the following system of equations:
$\left\{\begin{aligned}x_{1} + 3x_{2} - 2x_{3} &=-5 \\ x_{2} - x_{3} &=\frac{3}{2} \\ x_{3} &=-4\end{aligned}\right.$

Solve the following system of equations:
    

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}x+y+z &=\frac{1}{2} \\ y+z &=1 \\ z &=2\end{aligned}\right.
$$

Solve the following system of equations:
    

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}-{x}_{2}+{x}_{3} &=1 \\ {x}_{2}-{x}_{3} &=-1 \\ {x}_{3} &=3\end{aligned}\right.
$$

Solve the following system of equations:
    

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}x-y-z &=4 \\ y+2z &=2 \\ z &=\frac{1}{2}\end{aligned}\right.
$$

Solve the following system of equations:
    

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}-{x}_{2}+3{x}_{3} &=9 \\ {x}_{2}-3{x}_{3} &=2 \\ {x}_{3} &=\frac{1}{3}\end{aligned}\right.
$$

Solve the following system of equations:
    

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}x-y-z &=3 \\ y-z &=2 \\ z &=1\end{aligned}\right.
$$

Solve the following system of equations:
    

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}-2{x}_{2}+{x}_{3} &=2 \\ {x}_{2}+{x}_{3} &=-\frac{1}{2} \\ {x}_{3} &=-1\end{aligned}\right.
$$

Solve the following system of equations:
    

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}x+y-z &=2 \\ y-z &=\frac{1}{2} \\ z &=3\end{aligned}\right.
$$

Solve the following system of equations:
    

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}-{x}_{2}-{x}_{3} &=4 \\ {x}_{2}+{x}_{3} &=2 \\ {x}_{3} &=-2\end{aligned}\right.
$$

Solve the following system of equations:
    

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}+{x}_{2}-{x}_{3} &=2 \\ {x}_{2}-6{x}_{3} &=3 \\ {x}_{3} &=-\frac{1}{3}\end{aligned}\right.
$$

Solve the following system of equations:
    

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}x-y-z &=4 \\ y+z &=2 \\ z &=3\end{aligned}\right.
$$

Solve the following system of equations:
    

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}-2{x}_{2}-{x}_{3} &=\frac{1}{2} \\ {x}_{2}-{x}_{3} &=-\frac{3}{2} \\ {x}_{3} &=5\end{aligned}\right.
$$
